transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before I issue today's vehicle assignments and dispatch board, let's run through our standard transport-board huddle. I need the transportation, medical, signal, and engineer representatives to report any load requirements or vehicle-control considerations for today's four moves: the cold-storage cases to the medical annex, the communications mast to the north relay point, the generator to the engineering yard, and the administrative pallets to the headquarters warehouse. Please speak up so I can match the right vehicles to the right jobs.
